build.//: Turborepo runs tasks in a scrubbed environment — anything not listed here is stripped before the build sees it, silently. These are read at BUILD time (baked into Next's output or its security headers), so a missing one doesn't error, it just produces a deployment quietly configured for localhost. Runtime-only secrets (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, SMTP_*, …) are deliberately absent: they're read per-request by the API, never at build time.
